title: traveller
description: The fibration Trav over the ambient relational category whose fibre over each nucleus is the category of traveller-states it can support, with a transport functor f_* pushing states along any ambient morphism (in particular a portal). The thing-that-crosses: the slot into which a concrete cosmology plugs its moving content (matter, observer-states, information-quanta).

fibre-over.description: for each nucleus, the category of traveller-states supportable on it

transport.description: each ambient morphism f : X → Y induces f_* : Trav(X) → Trav(Y), pushing states along it (and along portals)
